# Pretest 1: Rewarding
```{r}
#loading data
Pre <- read.csv("~/Pre-test 1 Data.csv")
```

```{r}
#Demographics
Pre$Gender <- factor(Pre$Gender)
levels(Pre$Gender) <- c('female', 'non-binary', 'male')
Pre  %>% count(Gender)
Pre$Age <- as.numeric(Pre$Age)
summary(Pre$Age)
```

```{r}
#Is the card considered an incentive?; scale midpoint = 5
with(Pre, t.test(Rewarding[Seed==1], mu=5))
with(Pre, t.test(Rewarding[Seed==-1], mu=5))
```

# Pretest 2: Economic value
```{r}
#loading data
Pre <- read.csv("~/Pre-test 2 Data.csv")
Pre <- Pre %>% filter(Value < mean(Value)+3*sd(Value))
```

```{r}
#Demographics
Pre$Gender <- factor(Pre$Gender)
levels(Pre$Gender) <- c('female', 'non-binary', 'male')
Pre  %>% count(Gender)
Pre$Age <- as.numeric(Pre$Age)
summary(Pre$Age)
```

```{r}
#Economic value
t.test(Value ~ Seed, data=Pre, var.equal=T)

Means.Table<-Pre %>%
  group_by(Seed) %>%
  summarise(N=n(),
            Means=mean(Value),
            SD=sd(Value),
            SE=SD/N^.5)
print(Means.Table)
```
